## 🐋 WhaleTrace → Supabase Sync

**POST /whaletrace-supabase-sync**

接收 Python 爬蟲資料，寫入 Supabase 三張表：
1. stock_snapshots — 籌碼快照
2. insider_trades — 內部人交易
3. institutional_holdings — 機構持股

Body 格式：
```json
{
  "tickers": ["AAPL","NVDA"],
  "stock_snapshots": [...],
  "insider_trades": [...],
  "institutional_holdings": [...]
}
```

同步策略：DELETE (by ticker) → INSERT

Python 爬蟲：`python whaletrace_scraper.py --sync-supabase`
